Prefer specific place pages and precise Google Maps links over generic listing pages. Include a rating and a short descriptive note for each item when available, using a clear numeric format for the rating. Keep only highly rated items (>4.3), include a mixture of experiences, and keep only places likely open on the indicated dates. Include only suggestions with reliable clickable links.
